title: Clan standards rebuilt in 3D
changes: The clan war standards, where you swear your oath to a clan, are now 3D-built banner poles: a stone plinth, a gilt finial and the clan's swallow-tailed banner waving in the wind.
The clan crowned by the Reckoning flies a gold crown on its poles, and a hero with no clan who sacks a Hold raises a torn grey rag.
